chapter: Chano Pozo, Town Hall and Charlie Parker
title: Chano Pozo's first night at La Conga
summary: Chano arrived in May 1946 recovering from a gunshot wound, and could not dance, so he did a barber routine around Pepe Beque.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: Okay. In May of '46, Chano Pozo, Cacha and Pepe Veque came to the United States. What do you remember about that?
Well, in that particular time we was at La Conga with Bert Longworth and when he got there, Miguelito Valdes and Diosa Costelo and Bobby Capo were ....
Were in the same bill with you?
In the same bill, tremendous show.....
.... with chorus girls and everything. Oh!! it was a bombshell.
All right, I want you to try and think back of that night in '46 when Chano first appeared there. What happened that night?
He was dressed in white and he had an operation about three months before. He cannot dance as much as he wanted, because he was a great dancer, people, they didn't know .....
What did he have an operation for?
Because he got shot in Havana.
Oh yes! Is that where he tried to get some royalties?
So he cannot dance, he just move a little bit.
You know what he did? In account that he could not dance, he sat Pepe Beque in a chair and he took one of the paper - ahh - I mean table ....
...tablecloth, and put it like a barber and he start dancing around with a scissor and Hah - that guy, he was terrific.
